title: Muslims Day-Prayer, Quran, Dua
description:
Your Daily Companion for Salah, Quran & Islamic Living

Muslims Day( Ex App Of Ramadan) is an Islamic app that helps Muslims stay connected with Allah throughout the day with prayer times, Azan and Adhan reminders, Quran, Duas, Dhikr, Qibla direction, Ramadan fasting tools, Islamic calendar, and daily Islamic guidance in one clean app.

Whether you are at home, at work, studying, travelling, or preparing for Ramadan, Muslims Day is designed to make your daily worship easier, calmer, and more consistent.

Prayer Times & Azan
Get location-based Salah times for Fajr, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, and Isha. Set prayer reminders, follow the current prayer countdown, and view start and end times for each prayer.

You can also check times for voluntary prayers such as Duha, Ishraq, Tahajjud, and other important prayer windows, along with restricted prayer times.

Quran with Translation & Tafsir
Read the Holy Quran with Arabic text and translation. Muslims Day also supports word-by-word meaning, simple translation, Tafsir, audio recitation, and recitations from well-known Qaris.

Built for daily Quran reading, reflection, memorization support, and a stronger connection with the Book of Allah.

Daily Duas & Dhikr
Find essential daily Duas and Dhikr for morning, evening, after Salah, before sleep, and important moments of life.

Create your own Dua list, bookmark Duas and Dhikr, and keep your daily remembrance organized.

Ramadan, Suhoor & Iftar
Prepare for Ramadan with Suhoor, Imsak, and Iftar times based on your location. Use countdowns and reminders to help organize fasting days with ease.

Muslims Day also supports fasting reminders for voluntary fasts such as Mondays and Thursdays, Ayyam al-Beed, Dhul Hijjah, and the Day of Arafah.

Qibla Compass & Islamic Tools
Find the Qibla direction, use a digital Tasbih counter, check sunrise and sunset times, and access useful tools for daily Islamic practice.

Islamic Calendar & Reminders
Follow Hijri dates, important Islamic days, and daily reminders. Receive Islamic knowledge, Hadith reminders, Quran verses, Darood reminders, Sunnah-based guidance, and useful learning notifications.

Designed for Muslims Worldwide
Muslims Day works for Muslims across United States, Canada, Indonesia, Malaysia, the Middle East, the United Kingdom, Bangladesh, India, Pakistan and many other countries.

The app supports location-based prayer times and useful Islamic tools wherever you are.

Why Muslims Choose Muslims Day
• Prayer times and Azan reminders
• Quran with translation, Tafsir, and audio recitation
• Daily Duas and Dhikr
• Ramadan, Suhoor, Imsak, and Iftar times
• Qibla direction and Tasbih counter
• Hijri calendar and Islamic reminders
• Light and dark themes
• English and Bengali language support
• No forced subscription
• A cleaner Islamic experience without inappropriate ads

Muslims Day is more than a prayer time app. It is built to help you build a better Muslim routine, remember Allah more often, read Quran more regularly, and stay connected to your worship every day.

Download Muslims Day and start building a stronger daily connection with Salah, Quran, Duas, Dhikr, and Islamic living.
